purpose: Close the remaining provenance gap in the existing StarBlox Diffusers adapter without changing workflows, canonical art, review authority, gameplay, persistence, economy, deployment, or accepted hashes.
guaranteesAdded: Planner model revision must be an immutable lowercase 40-character commit SHA.
Generated source paths may use the live public/assets/catalog-candidates/ convention as well as public/assets/catalog/, while still binding itemId + producer + numeric version.
Generation verifies installed Diffusers VCS provenance from direct_url.json and fails unless its resolved commit equals the factory-pinned commit.
Generation resolves the Hugging Face model snapshot by exact revision and fails unless the resolved snapshot commit exactly equals the planned revision.
Reference-conditioned IP-Adapter execution similarly resolves and verifies an exact snapshot revision before loading.
Generation requires a real Git checkout on screenshot-match-preproduction and records the exact execution HEAD.
Generation receipts distinguish the planned source head from execution checkout head instead of implying they are identical.
The executed deterministic seed is recorded explicitly.
Generated output receipts include SHA-256 and canonical Git blob SHA.
Existing output paths are never overwritten with different bytes; identical bytes may be reused idempotently.
No review decision, canonical mapping, deployment, gameplay/state, or real-player-data mutation is performed by the adapter.

compatibility.verifierPathContract: Compatible: downstream verifier accepts safe asset paths and requires the filename stem to contain itemId + producer + numeric version.
compatibility.currentRequestConvention: Compatible with catalog-candidates source paths such as <item>-w<producer>-vN-<variant>-original.png.
